topics.purpose: Define subscriptions as explicit read/projection identities over exact DWH source scopes, change types and filters with separate runtime cursor/delivery state.

semantics.identity_rule: Each configured subscription has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.filter_rule: Record/field/change-type filters are explicit and schema-resolved.
semantics.projection_rule: Delivered payload fields/profile are explicit and governed.
semantics.cursor_rule: Subscription definition identity is distinct from runtime cursor/delivery-session identity.
semantics.start_rule: Start position such as current, exact watermark, snapshot boundary or explicit historical position is declared.
semantics.authorization_rule: Subscription creation/read/delivery obeys source governance and does not grant mutation authority.

invariants.rule: DWH changefeeds expose committed mutation evidence as ordered provenance-bearing data/events; subscription delivery never directly executes downstream operations and never replaces the underlying record/revision identities.
